description: This file defines data structures and functions for loading and parsing gateway configuration settings from a JSON file in a macOS application. It includes structs for configuration data and a function to read, parse, and populate these structures based on external JSON data.

methods.name: loadGatewayConfig
methods.description: Loads and parses the gateway configuration from a JSON file in the user's home directory, returning an instance of GatewayConfig with data populated from the JSON.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Attempts to convert a given value into an integer, handling inputs of type Int, Double, or String, or returning nil if conversion isn't possible.
